frames.frame: (Excuse me,) could/can you (please) tell me where [wh-从句·陈述语序]?
frames.gloss: 礼貌地向陌生人问路、求助的固定开场句式。
frames.pattern_notes: 固定礼貌开场（Excuse me / Could you please tell me / Do you know）后接 wh-宾语从句，从句必须用陈述语序（where the restrooms are）。学习者易直译为 where are the restrooms。开场成分可替换（Excuse me, can you tell me… / Do you know…），整存整取价值高。

examples.s: Could you please tell me where the restrooms are?
Can you please tell me where the nearest station is?
Boy 1: Excuse me, can you tell me where I can buy some medicine?
A: Excuse me, do you know where I can get some postcards?

frames.gloss: 句尾现在分词短语，对主句表自然结果、补充说明或附加评注。
frames.pattern_notes: 逗号后的 -ing 分词逻辑主语是主句主语，表主句动作带来的结果或顺势补评，可多个并列（providing…, feeding…, and offering…）。区别于已收录的句首分词状语：句尾位置学习者易误读为修饰紧邻的名词，或漏掉其因果意味。

examples.s: All around the world, the Red Cross continues to help civilians caught in war, providing medical assistance, feeding the needy, and offering many other types of aid.
The bushes and maple trees outside their windows were red, gold, and orange, and there was frost on the ground, confirming that autumn had arrived in Canada.
Guangxi is full of karsts, giving it some of the most interesting—and beautiful—scenery in the world.

frames.frame: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 (+ 范围短语 / ever 完成体从句)
frames.gloss: 表示“最……的……之一”，可再接范围或“有史以来”从句加强。
frames.pattern_notes: one of the 后固定接最高级加复数名词，学习者易漏名词复数或误用原级。加强版接 (that) sb has ever V-ed 表示“我所经历过的最……的”，从句用现在完成体。范围可用 in 短语或 of 短语给出。

examples.s: The Little Tramp chews on the lower part of the boot, treating it like something good to eat and making you believe that this is one of the best meals he has ever tasted.

UNIT 5 LANGUAGES AROUND THE WORLD THE BOOK THAT KEEPS ON GROWING It is one of the most famous books in the world; yet it has no story and no interesting characters, no exciting beginning and no satisfying ending.
This strangely popular book is one of the most famous dictionaries in the English- speaking world, the Oxford English Dictionary.
They were one of the most romantic literary couples of the Victorian era.

frames.frame: [数字] times as [形容词] (as/than) [B] / [数字] times [比较级] than [B]
frames.gloss: 用倍数表达“是……的几倍”或“比……多几倍”。
frames.pattern_notes: 倍数固定在 as...as 结构或比较级之前（four times larger than）。真实文本中存在 as...than 混用（twice as likely… than people who…），学习者容易把倍数放错位置，或把 twice as likely to die 误读成单纯“更容易”。

examples.s: And in America, people who receive 25% of their daily calories or more through sugar are twice as likely to die from heart disease than people who receive less than 10% a day (Journal of the American Medical Association, 2014).
This new park is nearly four times larger than the old wildlife park protecting Siberian tigers in Northeast China.

frames.gloss: “……的方式／样子”，way 后接省略关系词的定语从句。
frames.pattern_notes: way 后关系词 that 或 in which 通常整段省略，直接跟主谓结构（the way he was dressed）。学习者易误补 how（×the way how），或读不出省略导致断句错误；需与 the way to do / the way of doing 辨析。

examples.s: The shop assistant looked down on Gary because of the way he was dressed.
Good learners know the best way they can study.

candidates.note: not so much [A] as [B]（与其说是A，不如说是B）：骨架和误读判据都满足，但本批两个出处实为同一课文句（S01337 是 S06233 的加长版），只算 1 个独立句子，重复判据拿不准。

example.s: The real driver of poor health is not so much fatty food, as it is sugar.

candidates.note: While it is easy to [A], it is (much) harder to [B]：让步对比骨架工整，教学价值高，但本批只出现 1 次。

example.s: While it is easy to perceive when students are interested, bored, or distracted, it is sometimes much harder to distinguish when students are troubled.

candidates.note: only + 状语句首倒装（only now are we discovering…）：倒装骨架明显且会误读，本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: ” Plastic waste in the sea has long been known about, but only now are we discovering the true extent of the problem.

candidates.note: 地点/方位状语句首完全倒装（Around these are lines of…）：介词短语前置+主谓倒装，本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: Around these are lines of pure paint in different shades of blue, yellow, and white.

candidates.note: 承前省略并列：分号连接的并列分句中 be 动词承前省略（the streets open…; the shops well-furnished），正是 regex 盲区提示的类型，但本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: The houses are well-built; the streets open, straight, and well-paved; the shops well-furnished; and the markets well-supplied.

candidates.note: how [adj] it is, yet how [adj] it seems：感叹式 how 从句对举，结构漂亮，本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: One fascinating thing about the statue is how imperfect it is, yet how perfect it seems.

candidates.note: Before S V-ed, S had (already) V-ed：本批出现 2 次（另见 J02522），但判据 1 明确把时体类排除（过去完成只有规则没有骨架），记此存疑不收录。

example.s: Before I could join the others outside to see what was going on, the first plane had already hit my oﬃ ce building.

candidates.note: be impressed by [A]：本批 2 次（另见 S02174），但偏短语级动介搭配，句子级骨架弱，拿不准骨架判据。

example.s: ” We are impressed by the vastness and breathtaking beauty of the oceans.

candidates.note: not the only one who [V]：口语常用框架，本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: " Amy isn't the only one who is good at recycling.

candidates.note: You never know until you [V]：谚语式框架，本批仅此 1 例。

example.s: Y ou never know until you try something.

candidates.note: there be + 名词 + V-ing（存在句接现在分词）：本批干净例句仅此 1 个（S03842 同类但带填空残缺），重复判据拿不准。

example.s: However, there are some young minds working to clean up and protect the sea for future generations.
